blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Agriculture (DA) on Thursday ordered the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) to conduct a probe and dismantle reported unauthorized fish cages owned by Chinese-linked operators in Sual, Pangasinan.
